name: build-fleet
description: Spec-driven multi-agent software house. Ships product-owner, architect, coder, qa, devops, scribe, and classifier subagents that execute a deterministic SPEC → REVIEW → FINALIZE → BUILD → CHANGE_REVIEW → HANDOFF state machine. In v0.2 the REVIEW phase runs as a Claude Code dynamic workflow with adversarial cross-examination and survival-vote convergence; BUILD can fan out across partitioned coders. Hook-enforced gates, bounded review cycles, first-class human escalation, headless-mode support for orchestrators (Hermes / Agent SDK).
